newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida briefed on Friday's Development Council. He said discussions would focus on the adoption of a new cooperation agreement with South Africa, anti-personnel mines and the situation in the Great Lakes area.

Spokesman Filippo di Robilant briefed on Friday's Fisheries Council. He said the Commission was optimistic that an agreement would be reached on satellite surveillance but rather pessimistic on the fourth phase of the multi-annual guidance programme.

Spokesman Nicolaas Wegter briefed on Commissioners Sir Leon Brittan and Hans van den Broek's meeting with Russian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Trade Minister Oleg Davydov. He said discussions had focused on Russia's accession to the World Trade Organisation and EU/Russian relations notably in the field of textile and steel products.

Wegter said Davydoff had agreed with the broad lines of the Commission's proposals but had stressed his disagreement on full liberalisation of the textile market within four years. Wegter stressed that the meeting was continuing.
